SELECT 'crm'::text AS source_name, pgtrickle.encode_row_id_v2('MDM_SOURCE_KEY_V1', ROW((SELECT entity_id FROM mdm_graph.source_identity_map WHERE entity_name = 'person' AND source_name = 'crm'), (SELECT source_identity_id FROM mdm_graph.source_identity_map WHERE entity_name = 'person' AND source_name = 'crm'), "id")) AS source_record_key, "birth_date" AS "birth_date", "birth_date_state" AS "birth_date_state", "email" AS "email", "email_state" AS "email_state", "display_name" AS "name", "name_state" AS "name_state", "changed_at" AS row_changed_at
FROM public.mdm_crm
WHERE "deleted" IS NOT TRUE

SELECT 'erp'::text AS source_name, pgtrickle.encode_row_id_v2('MDM_SOURCE_KEY_V1', ROW((SELECT entity_id FROM mdm_graph.source_identity_map WHERE entity_name = 'person' AND source_name = 'erp'), (SELECT source_identity_id FROM mdm_graph.source_identity_map WHERE entity_name = 'person' AND source_name = 'erp'), "tenant_id", "external_id")) AS source_record_key, "birth_date" AS "birth_date", "birth_date_state" AS "birth_date_state", "email" AS "email", "email_state" AS "email_state", "legal_name" AS "name", "name_state" AS "name_state", "changed_at" AS row_changed_at
FROM public.mdm_erp

SELECT 'crm'::text AS source_name, r.source_record_key AS source_record_key, sr.source_record_id AS source_record_id, sr.source_record_key AS source_sort_key, 'name'::text AS field_name, r."name"::text AS raw_value, r.row_changed_at::timestamptz AS row_changed_at, n.state AS state, n.normalized AS normalized, n.canonical_bytes AS canonical_bytes
FROM @{records/crm} AS r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL mdm_graph.normalize_text((r."name")::text, 'text', 1, r."name_state", '{}'::jsonb) AS n
JOIN mdm_graph.source_records sr ON sr.source_record_key = r.source_record_key AND sr.active
JOIN mdm_graph.source_identity_map si ON si.source_identity_id = sr.source_identity_id AND si.source_name = 'crm'
UNION ALL

SELECT n0.source_record_id, n0.field_name, 'composite_person'::text AS channel_id, pg_catalog.int4send(pg_catalog.octet_length(n0.canonical_bytes)) || n0.canonical_bytes || pg_catalog.int4send(pg_catalog.octet_length(n1.canonical_bytes)) || n1.canonical_bytes AS block_key, n0.source_sort_key
FROM @{normalized/name} n0
JOIN @{normalized/birth_date} n1 USING (source_record_id, source_sort_key)
WHERE n0.field_name = 'name' AND n0.state = 'value' AND n1.field_name = 'birth_date' AND n1.state = 'value'

SELECT source_record_id, field_name, 'token_name'::text AS channel_id, token AS block_key, source_sort_key
FROM @{normalized/name}
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.regexp_split_to_table(normalized, '[[:space:]]+') AS token(token)
WHERE field_name = 'name' AND state = 'value' AND pg_catalog.char_length(token) >= 3
GROUP BY source_record_id, field_name, token, source_sort_key

SELECT left_source_record_id, right_source_record_id, left_sort_key, right_sort_key
FROM (
SELECT l.source_record_id AS left_source_record_id, r.source_record_id AS right_source_record_id, l.source_sort_key AS left_sort_key, r.source_sort_key AS right_sort_key
FROM @{blocks/composite_person} l
JOIN @{block-stats/composite_person} s ON s.channel_id = l.channel_id AND s.block_key = l.block_key
JOIN @{blocks/composite_person} r ON r.channel_id = l.channel_id AND r.block_key = l.block_key AND l.source_sort_key < r.source_sort_key
WHERE s.block_records <= 2
UNION ALL

SELECT evidence.left_source_record_id, evidence.right_source_record_id, evidence.left_sort_key, evidence.right_sort_key, evidence.rule, evidence.evidence_group, evidence.class, evidence.score, evidence.comparator, evidence.comparator_version, evidence.left_value_digest, evidence.right_value_digest
FROM (SELECT p.left_source_record_id, p.right_source_record_id, p.left_sort_key, p.right_sort_key, 'exact_email'::text AS rule, 'email'::text AS evidence_group, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN l0.canonical_bytes = r0.canonical_bytes THEN 'agree'::text ELSE 'disagree'::text END ELSE 'no_evidence'::text END AS class, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN NULL::smallint ELSE NULL::smallint END AS score, 'exact_v1'::text AS comparator, 1::smallint AS comparator_version, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), l0.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS left_value_digest, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), r0.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS right_value_digest
FROM @{pairs/person} p
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/email} l0 ON l0.source_record_id = p.left_source_record_id AND l0.field_name = 'email'
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/email} r0 ON r0.source_record_id = p.right_source_record_id AND r0.field_name = 'email'
UNION ALL
SELECT p.left_source_record_id, p.right_source_record_id, p.left_sort_key, p.right_sort_key, 'prefix_name'::text AS rule, 'name'::text AS evidence_group, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN mdm_graph.normalized_levenshtein_score(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), l0.normalized), pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), r0.normalized), (SELECT COALESCE((d.expanded_definition->'limits'->>'max_comparator_work')::bigint, 1000000::bigint) FROM mdm_graph.definition_limits d WHERE d.entity_name = 'person'::text))::smallint >= 8000 THEN 'agree'::text ELSE 'disagree'::text END ELSE 'no_evidence'::text END AS class, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.normalized_levenshtein_score(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), l0.normalized), pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), r0.normalized), (SELECT COALESCE((d.expanded_definition->'limits'->>'max_comparator_work')::bigint, 1000000::bigint) FROM mdm_graph.definition_limits d WHERE d.entity_name = 'person'::text))::smallint ELSE NULL::smallint END AS score, 'normalized_levenshtein_v1'::text AS comparator, 1::smallint AS comparator_version, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), l0.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS left_value_digest, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), r0.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS right_value_digest
FROM @{pairs/person} p
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/name} l0 ON l0.source_record_id = p.left_source_record_id AND l0.field_name = 'name'
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/name} r0 ON r0.source_record_id = p.right_source_record_id AND r0.field_name = 'name'
UNION ALL
SELECT p.left_source_record_id, p.right_source_record_id, p.left_sort_key, p.right_sort_key, 'token_name'::text AS rule, 'name_token'::text AS evidence_group, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN l0.canonical_bytes = r0.canonical_bytes THEN 'agree'::text ELSE 'disagree'::text END ELSE 'no_evidence'::text END AS class, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN NULL::smallint ELSE NULL::smallint END AS score, 'exact_v1'::text AS comparator, 1::smallint AS comparator_version, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), l0.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS left_value_digest, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), r0.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS right_value_digest
FROM @{pairs/person} p
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/name} l0 ON l0.source_record_id = p.left_source_record_id AND l0.field_name = 'name'
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/name} r0 ON r0.source_record_id = p.right_source_record_id AND r0.field_name = 'name'
UNION ALL
SELECT p.left_source_record_id, p.right_source_record_id, p.left_sort_key, p.right_sort_key, 'composite_person'::text AS rule, 'person'::text AS evidence_group, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND l1.state = 'value' AND r1.state = 'value' AND l1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN l0.canonical_bytes = r0.canonical_bytes AND l1.canonical_bytes = r1.canonical_bytes THEN 'agree'::text ELSE 'disagree'::text END ELSE 'no_evidence'::text END AS class, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND l1.state = 'value' AND r1.state = 'value' AND l1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN NULL::smallint ELSE NULL::smallint END AS score, 'exact_v1'::text AS comparator, 1::smallint AS comparator_version, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND l1.state = 'value' AND r1.state = 'value' AND l1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), l0.normalized, l1.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS left_value_digest, CASE WHEN l0.state = 'value' AND r0.state = 'value' AND l0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r0.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND l1.state = 'value' AND r1.state = 'value' AND l1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL AND r1.canonical_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN mdm_graph.evidence_digest(pg_catalog.concat_ws(pg_catalog.chr(31), r0.normalized, r1.normalized)) ELSE NULL::bytea END AS right_value_digest
FROM @{pairs/person} p
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/name} l0 ON l0.source_record_id = p.left_source_record_id AND l0.field_name = 'name'
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/name} r0 ON r0.source_record_id = p.right_source_record_id AND r0.field_name = 'name'
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/birth_date} l1 ON l1.source_record_id = p.left_source_record_id AND l1.field_name = 'birth_date'
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/birth_date} r1 ON r1.source_record_id = p.right_source_record_id AND r1.field_name = 'birth_date') AS evidence
LEFT JOIN @{blocks/composite_person} AS dependency_0 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{blocks/exact_email} AS dependency_1 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{blocks/prefix_name} AS dependency_2 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{blocks/token_name} AS dependency_3 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-stats/composite_person} AS dependency_4 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-stats/exact_email} AS dependency_5 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-stats/prefix_name} AS dependency_6 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-stats/token_name} AS dependency_7 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-overflow/composite_person} AS dependency_8 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-overflow/exact_email} AS dependency_9 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-overflow/prefix_name} AS dependency_10 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{block-overflow/token_name} AS dependency_11 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/name} AS dependency_12 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/email} AS dependency_13 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{normalized/birth_date} AS dependency_14 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{pairs/person} AS dependency_15 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{pair-stats/person} AS dependency_16 ON false
LEFT JOIN @{pair-overflow/person} AS dependency_17 ON false

SELECT n.source_record_id, n.source_name, n.field_name, CASE n.source_name WHEN 'crm' THEN 0 WHEN 'erp' THEN 1 ELSE 2147483647 END::integer AS source_priority, n.row_changed_at, false AS authoritative, n.source_sort_key, n.raw_value, n.state, n.normalized, n.canonical_bytes
FROM @{normalized/name} n
LEFT JOIN @{evidence/person} AS evidence_dependency ON false
WHERE n.field_name = 'name'
/* @{evidence/person} */
